title: 2D and 2.5D space travel(WIP)
author: crypticevincar
selftext: I was thinking about older space games like StarFlight where everything exists in a 2D plane. Travel is all north, south, left and right and you can get to every planet in the system. It's great, it's easy and it keeps you from having pitch, yaw, roll, etc. I always wanted to have those planets further away. Something that did require some navigation to get to. But I wanted other objects in that same space to have that ability too. And then I did this. Is it revolutionary? No. Is it fun? Yes. To me. Short video demo of how the player controlled ship moves into and out of 2.5D travel is attached. Thoughts? Questions? Criticisms?

comments.author: StellarSoupStudio
comments.body: Really neat demo! Is the gravity simulated or a rails + fixed orbit system?

replies.author: crypticevincar
replies.body: Thanks! Its fixed orbit. Get within to far, press a button and you start orbiting. When I posted this (I realize it was only 2 hours ago) the orbiting was only in 2D, but now you can enter orbit in 3D too and switch between views like you would  normally.
